Our Origin

A Promise Born
in the Soil

"Sri Raagni Organics was born not in a boardroom, but in the soil of Chintalapudi — a small village near Tenali, Andhra Pradesh."

Our founder's father is a farmer — rooted in the land, guided by seasons. During COVID, families began questioning the purity of everyday food, sparking a powerful realization: When food is pure, health follows naturally.


Blending farm-grown produce, ancestral practices, and Ayurvedic wisdom, Sri Raagni Organics took shape — not as a business, but as a responsibility.
